pages.lesson:
LESSON: BOOK HANDLING READING

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Book handling READING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Book handling READING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate ability to turn pages from right to left when opening a page in and out of school.
2. Take pleasure in book handling and storage activities in and out of school. practise dusting, covering and arranging books at appropriate places. Core-competence developed Communication and collaboration, digital literacy, learning to learn.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate ability to turn pages from right to left when opening a page in and out of school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate ability to turn pages from right to left when opening a page in and out of school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Take pleasure in book handling and storage activities in and out of school. practise dusting, covering and arranging books at appropriate places. Core-competence developed Communication and collaboration, digital literacy, learning to learn.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to take pleasure in book handling and storage activities in and out of school. practise dusting, covering and arranging books at appropriate places. Core-competence developed Communication and collaboration, digital literacy, learning to learn. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Book handling READING.
2. Explain Book handling READING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Book handling READING.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate ability to turn pages from right to left when opening a page in and out of school.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Book handling READING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when reading?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate ability to turn pages from right to left when opening a page in and out of school.
2. Take pleasure in book handling and storage activities in and out of school. practise dusting, covering and arranging books at appropriate places. Core-competence developed Communication and collaboration, digital literacy, learning to learn.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
